snippet.title: Heroes of Valor Teaser - Fancy Cat Interactive x Iceberg announcement
snippet.description:
Hello heroes!

Here's a brand new teaser that shows the latest state of the game and the announcement of our colaboration with Iceberg Interactive who will publish the game from this point onward. :)

Check out our new updated Steam storepage:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504090/Heroes_of_Valor/

And join the free open playtest to try the game out for yourself!

Cheers and see you on the Battlefield!
